title: Business Central 2025 wave 2 (BC27): RecordRef – Get/Search field by name (New overloads)
summary: Business Central 2025 wave 2 (BC27) adds new overloads to RecordRef Field and FieldExist methods that enable searching for fields by their name instead of field number, simplifying AL code when working with dynamic field references.
key_points: New overloads accept Text parameter for field name in RecordRef.Field() and RecordRef.FieldExist() methods
Replaces previous workaround approach for getting field information by field name
Requires runtime version 16.0 or greater; not available in version 15.0
Makes AL code cleaner when you need to access fields dynamically by name rather than field ID

quotes.text: New overloads are added to the Field and FieldExist methods, which allows searching for a field by its name.
quotes.why_it_matters: This is the core feature announcement that directly describes what BC27 adds to simplify field access in AL code.

quotes.text: 'Field' is not available in runtime version '15.0'. The supported runtime versions are: '16.0' or greater.
quotes.why_it_matters: Critical compatibility detail that developers must know to avoid deployment issues when using the new overloads.
